summary: The restored boundary is now present and has focused unit proof. It remains a pure reusable policy layer; route, session, and OIDC behavior stay in later stages.
current_flow: Browser requests now have cookie, credential, origin, CSRF, loopback, and exhaustive role policy helpers. No route can turn a browser session into a Bearer credential.

criteria_map.Browser and Bearer credentials are mutua: browser-auth-boundary.ts supplies cookie, credential-detection, and no-store helpers, proven by its focused test.
criteria_map.Browser mutations can require exact cano: browser-auth-boundary.ts supplies exact Origin, CSRF hash comparison, and loopback checks without accepting host aliases.
criteria_map.Every Control scope is classified as Adm: browser-scope-policy.ts uses satisfies Record<Scope,...>; focused tests cover map completeness and Viewer write denial.
